name: Tateyama (Toyama, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tateyama town emblem in white: an outlined ring with three pointed rays enclosing a three-armed device.
history: Municipal flag of Tateyama, a town in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1954.

features.role: Tateyama town emblem — an outlined ring with three pointed rays enclosing a three-armed device
